name: Indrani
description: Dr. Indrani hides her pain with forced smiles. Young Dr. Aditya falls for her warmth. Can love break through societal pressure and give her happiness?

videos.title: A lost mother's journey
videos.overview: Indrani, Chief Administrator at the hospital, wakes up from a nightmare and begins her day. But joy fills the air - Mayukh Ranjan Purakayastha's grandson is arriving.
